title: Private Schools Must Display Fee Structure Under RTI Act
summary: A recent ruling by the Madras High Court has clarified that private schools are not considered 'public authorities' under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, but must still display their fee structures as per state regulations. This decision aims to ensure transparency in education and protect students' rights.
summary_points: Private schools are exempt from RTI Act's public authority provisions
Must display fee structure as per state regulations
Decision aims to promote transparency in education
Clarifies ambiguity on private school disclosure under RTI
